:::{#def-optimization-algorithm}
#### Optimization algorithm

An **optimization algorithm** $\optalg$ is a step-by-step procedure that searches a [model family](#def-model-family) $\modelfam$
for a member $\modmem$ with a small value of an [objective function](#def-objective-function) $\objfn$:

$$
\modmem = \optalg\paren{\modelfam, \objfn, \dataset} \in \modelfam.
$$ {#eq-optimization-algorithm}

:::
